Salma and Felix are going on a trip to the jungle. They packed their duffle bags and got on a plane to Brazil. Once in Brazil, they rode a shuttle to the jungle. In the jungle, they saw an anaconda in the grass. They also saw a sloth dangle from a vine.

slides.text: At the end of their trip, they even got to see a puma! Pumas like to hide, so not many people get to see them in the wild. Salma and Felix were thrilled. “I am so happy we got to see these animals,” said Salma. “Me too!” said Felix.
